name: Northwest Youth Corps Youth Camping Crews
what_you_do: Teens camp for the whole session. They plant trees, thin brush, pull invasive plants, build trails and put up fences on public land in the Northwest.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 18. No experience needed. Crews start and end in Eugene, OR or Boise, ID. You provide your own transportation to and from orientation.
pay_detail: Up to $450 a week with bonuses, after $70 a week is deducted for food. $300 tuition fee, with need-based assistance.
duration: 4 to 5 weeks living outdoors (2026: June 13 to July 18; July 25 to Aug 29 or 30)
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply link on the Youth Camping page (Northwest Youth Corps application site). Contact info@nwyouthcorps.org.
notes: This is hard: you camp and work in all weather. If you leave before graduation you get a share of the stipend and lose the bonuses. The page lists possible high school credit. Oregon BOLI does not give work permits to minors ages 14 to 17. Employers need a certificate to hire minors.
